store.summary: 60fps wireless screen casting, mirroring & web console | 60帧无线投屏与网页控台
store.description: Self-hosted web console (:8787) and high-speed LAN screen-casting receiver for CardputerZero (320x170 RGB565). View a live 16-bit screen mirror in any browser, drag-drop or Ctrl+V paste images, switch among 10 built-in UI/photo/calibration test patterns, tune color modes and Bayer dither live, and lock stream frame pacing (1-120 FPS or unlimited) for smooth video playback and 60 FPS game casting via HTTP POST /push. Supports En/Cn UI switch and keypad shortcuts (4-8, ESC).
